maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: "Loan amounts over $150,000 and up to 97% of the property value including Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium (Lenders Mortgage Insurance applicable over 80% LVR)". i.e. 95% base LVR plus a capitalised LMI premium to a 97% hard ceiling — the home-loan comparison page states the maximum loan amount as "95% of property value plus LMI".

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026

lmiCapitalisable.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
lmiCapitalisable.note: The 97% ceiling is expressly "including Lenders Mortgage Insurance premium", so the premium may be added on top of the base loan.

lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.note: The 97% figure is stated as inclusive of the LMI premium.

notes.value: Maximum LVR by product (home loan comparison page): No Frills 95% + LMI; Premium Choice 95% + LMI; Variable Rate Offset (Country to Coast) 95% + LMI; Lifestyle 80%; Access Equity 80%.
notes.note: asAt is the retrieval date — the comparison page carries no publication date. The 95%+LMI figure is corroborated by the 19 February 2026 TMD.

maxLandSizeHa.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
maxLandSizeHa.note: Listed under consumers for whom the product is clearly unsuitable: those who "Need to purchase a property over eight (8) hectares".

notes.value: Security property must be domiciled in Australia and the borrower must give a registered first mortgage over real property or other acceptable security. Properties over 8 hectares are outside the No Frills product's target market. The Capricornian also runs a dedicated Lifestyle Property loan for rural/lifestyle blocks and Rural & Regional home loans.
notes.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026

minLoanAmount.note: Minimum loan varies by product: Premium Choice $50,000; Lifestyle $50,000; No Frills $150,000; Variable Rate Offset (Country to Coast) $250,000; Access Equity (an equity line, 7-year term) $5,000. $50,000 is the lowest ordinary home-loan minimum. asAt is the retrieval date; the No Frills $150,000 minimum is independently confirmed by the 19 February 2026 TMD ("Borrowers who require a loan less than $150,000" are listed as unsuitable).

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
maxLoanTermYears.note: "Loan terms of up to 30 years" — matches the comparison page for No Frills, Premium Choice, Lifestyle and Variable Rate Offset. Access Equity is 7 years.

offsetAvailable.note: 100% offset on Premium Choice, Lifestyle and Variable Rate Offset. NOT available on No Frills or Access Equity — the No Frills TMD expressly lists clients "seeking to attach an offset facility" as unsuitable. asAt is the retrieval date.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw of advance repayments; free online and mobile redraws (fee applies in branch). Not available on fixed-rate options; fixed loans permit up to $10,000 of additional repayments a year without penalty.

constructionAvailable.note: Construction available on No Frills, Premium Choice, Lifestyle and Variable Rate Offset; not on Access Equity. The No Frills TMD offers interest-only during construction at a 1% margin (0.50% margin for ordinary interest-only). asAt is the retrieval date.

notes.value: The Capricornian is a member-owned Central Queensland bank founded in 1959, with eight branches across Rockhampton, Yeppoon, Emerald, Gladstone and surrounding towns. Broker-distributed: the TMD lists "The Capricornian Broker Network relationships" alongside branches, mobile lenders, call centre and online. Borrowers must be, or become, shareholding members of The Capricornian Bank — a mutual membership requirement that is an explicit target-market condition. No monthly loan fees on the home loan range; an establishment fee applies. Interest-only is available to approved applicants at a 0.50% margin (1% for construction). No penalty for extra repayments or early payout on variable products. The No Frills owner-occupied product is expressly NOT for investors — use the No Frills Investment or Premium Choice Investment products.
notes.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026

value.conditions: Target market is retail clients who "are an Australian resident and whose potential security property is domiciled in Australia", aged 18 or over.
Covered by the same "Australian resident" wording; the TMD does not distinguish citizens from permanent residents.

rules.sourceTitle: The Capricornian Bank Target Market Determination — No Frills Owner Occupied Variable Rate Home Loan, 19 February 2026
rules.note: The TMD says only "Australian resident"; it does not name visa subclasses, NZ citizens, expats or non-residents. Those are unresearched, not declined.

gaps: No servicing buffer, assessment floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, HEM basis, credit-card assessment rate or commitment treatment published.
No income-type policy at all — casual, contract, probation, overtime, bonus, commission, self-employed and Centrelink treatment are unpublished.
No credit-history policy published (defaults, arrears, bankruptcy, enquiries, credit score).
No maximum loan amount published for any product.
No LMI provider named and no LMI waiver professions published.
No minimum unit floor area, high-density apartment, postcode-category or company-title policy published.
Lending area is not stated; as a Central Queensland mutual there may be a geographic restriction that is simply not published — the 'Rural & Regional Home Loans QLD' framing suggests a QLD focus.

Ten separate product TMDs are published (June 2026 uploads, dated February 2026); only the No Frills Owner Occupied Variable one was read in full. The investment and Premium Choice TMDs may carry different LVR/loan-size rules.
Government scheme participation (Home Guarantee Scheme / 5% Deposit Scheme) not established.
